<function name="EffectData" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns a <page>CEffectData</page> object to be used with <page>util.Effect</page>.

<bug issue="2771">This does not create a unique object, but instead returns a shared reference. That means you cannot use two or more of these objects at once.

As a result any values previously set (Origin, Magnitude, Scale etc) will carry over to all future calls of this function, and may unexpectedly affect effects created via <page>util.Effect</page>.
</bug>

	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="CEffectData">The <page>CEffectData</page> object.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
